name: Octamoxin
summary: Octamoxin (trade names Ximaol, Nimaol), also known as 2-octylhydrazine, is an irreversible and nonselective monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class that was used as an antidepressant in the 1960s but is now no longer marketed.

pharmacology.text: Octamoxin (trade names Ximaol, Nimaol), also known as 2-octylhydrazine, is an irreversible and nonselective monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI) of the hydrazine class that was used as an antidepressant in the 1960s but is now no longer marketed.

summaryZh: 奧他莫辛是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C8H20N2，屬於聯氨類單胺氧化酶抑制劑，能用作抗抑鬱藥，但已不再銷售。
summaryZhHans: 奥他莫辛是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C8H20N2，属于联氨类单胺氧化酶抑制剂，能用作抗抑郁药，但已不再销售。

sideEffects.en: MAO inhibitors of this class can cause a dangerous rise in blood pressure when certain foods or medicines are taken, and this family was withdrawn largely because of liver damage.
sideEffects.zh: 這一類單胺氧化酶抑制劑在攝取某些食物或藥物時，可能造成血壓危險升高；這個家族大多因肝損傷而撤市。
sideEffects.zhHans: 这一类单胺氧化酶抑制剂在摄取某些食物或药物时，可能造成血压危险升高；这个家族大多因肝损伤而撤市。

fact.en: It is a hydrazine MAO inhibitor, a family that came out of leftover rocket fuel chemistry after the Second World War and was then found to lift mood in tuberculosis patients.
fact.zh: 它屬於肼類單胺氧化酶抑制劑。這個家族源自二戰後剩餘火箭燃料的化學研究，後來被發現能改善結核病患者的情緒。
fact.zhHans: 它属于肼类单胺氧化酶抑制剂。这个家族源自二战后剩余火箭燃料的化学研究，后来被发现能改善结核病患者的情绪。
